title: thlaspi spinosum
intro: Thlaspi spinosum, commonly known as prickly orpine, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is used for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Thlaspi spinosum include antimicrobial and antifungal properties, making it a potential treatment for various infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
